evals.prompt: need a VBA macro for SW 2024: for the active part, activate each configuration and save a STEP AP214 next to the part as partname_config.step. some parts have 40 configs. give me a .bas I can import
evals.expected_output: Importable early-bound .bas macro that loops GetConfigurationNames, activates each configuration with ShowConfiguration2, sets AP214 through the swStepAP user preference, exports with ModelDocExtension.SaveAs3 checking Errors/Warnings, restores the original configuration and preference, and cites the doc paths used.
expectations: Exports with ModelDocExtension.SaveAs3 (Extension.SaveAs3) and never calls ModelDoc2.SaveAs, SaveAs2 or SaveAs3
Declares Errors and Warnings as Long, passes them to SaveAs3 and checks them or the Boolean return
Loops configurations with GetConfigurationNames plus ShowConfiguration2 and reactivates the originally active configuration
Uses swconst names (swSaveAsCurrentVersion, swSaveAsOptions_Silent, swStepAP) rather than bare numbers
Transcript shows swapi.py lookups for SaveAs3 and ShowConfiguration2 before the code was written

evals.prompt: C# add-in for SOLIDWORKS 2025: task pane with a textbox and a button. button renames every top-level component in the active assembly to PREFIX-001, PREFIX-002... where PREFIX is the textbox text. full project please, I'll build it in VS 2022
evals.expected_output: Complete net48 x64 add-in project: ISwAddin class with COM registration, task pane via CreateTaskpaneView3 hosting a ComVisible UserControl, rename logic over GetComponents(true) setting IComponent2.Name2 with swExtRefUpdateCompNames turned off and restored, build and registration steps.
expectations: A class implements ISwAddin with ConnectToSW and DisconnectFromSW and is ComVisible with a Guid
Registration code writes the SolidWorks Addins (HKLM) and AddInsStartup (HKCU) registry keys or the answer gives equivalent regasm steps
Creates the task pane with ISldWorks.CreateTaskpaneView3 (not the obsolete CreateTaskpaneView2) and ITaskpaneView.AddControl
Renames via IComponent2.Name2 after setting swExtRefUpdateCompNames to false and restores the previous value
Project file targets .NET Framework 4.x x64 and references SolidWorks.Interop.sldworks, swconst and swpublished with Embed Interop Types false

evals.prompt: we have about 2000 sldprt and sldasm files on \\fileserver\cad\released. I need Description, PartNo and Material custom properties, including configuration-specific ones, in a CSV. opening each in solidworks takes forever. c# console app, .NET Framework 4.8 is fine
evals.expected_output: Document Manager console app: license key read from configuration or environment, GetApplication, GetDocument per file with type from extension and read-only flag, file-level and per-configuration properties, CloseDoc for every document, error handling for open failures, CSV output, notes on the license key and file-version limits.
expectations: Uses the Document Manager API (SwDMClassFactory/ISwDMClassFactory.GetApplication) and not ISldWorks
Does not hardcode a license key literal; reads it from an environment variable or config and explains the key requirement
Opens documents read-only via GetDocument (or GetDocument2) and checks the SwDmDocumentOpenError result
Reads configuration-specific properties through the configuration manager and ISwDMConfiguration, using the non-obsolete GetConfigurationNames variant
Calls CloseDoc on every opened document inside a finally or equivalent path
